notes.title: Oculus Rift Update and some performance upgrades.
notes.notes:
In the latest update, we added full support for the Oculus touch controllers with correct rotation and trigger mapping.
Also, some performance updates are included.

notes.title: Price DROP!
notes.notes: We have lowered the price of Candy Kingdom, feel free to buy a copy and enjoy some candy shooting fun during the holidays!

notes.title: Meet us in London @ Develop:VR
notes.notes:

Should you be in the area, feel free to visit our stand, we would love to meet you ! 

Develop:VR will be held on the 24th, November 2016 at The Old Truman Brewery, 91 Brick Lane London.

notes.title: Candy Kingdom Update
notes.notes:
Hi all, 

we just updated Candy Kingdom, the update includes : 

- Tracks have been adjusted to prevent motion sickness
- Candy Blasters have received tool tips 
- Music and SFX can be adjusted 
- The 'horn' has fixed 
- improved overall performance

notes.title: Candy Kingdom All Ages
notes.notes:
We see that there is some discussion about the game being titled 'only for kids'. 

The purpose of Candy Kingdom was to create a (family) friendly all-round FPS based shooter for all ages. 

Its true, the first 6 levels are created for the younger ones. Our 5 year old and almost 3 year old are enjoying this a lot by just shooting around and enjoying the Candy Kingdom world.

However, we want to say that after level 6 the game will be more challenging and might be to hard to complete the levels by the younger viver's. 

Levels 7-18 are for the more 'older & experienced' players :)

Feel free to post a discussion to discus this further, we are more then happy to answer all your questions and feedback

notes.title: Candy Kingdom Released!
notes.notes:
Candy Kingdom is here! 

A fun candy shooting game for all ages in a wonderful environment! 

We would like to point out, that this is a game for all ages and not specific for the young ones. The levels as of 8 start to be more challenging....

Thanks for everybody that has been part of the beta to provide great feedback. 
The feedback was very positive and there is already a review posted by VR Today Magazine. 

Have fun in Candy Kingdom!
